packing_fix_proof.precision: Each endpoint uses the existing Float2Int rounding mode. Eight steps remain for safe small holders. Conservative signed range 32766.5 protects the positive boundary. Quantization at 4096 is 1/4 physical texel, equal to 1/16 logical texel at density 4.
